Tamil Nadu Govt Seeks State Election Commissioner's Resignation

The Tamil Nadu government has reportedly asked State Election Commissioner Jothi Nirmalasamy to resign. Ms. Nirmalasamy began her five-year term in March 2024, with her tenure scheduled to end in May 2029. The reasons for the government's request have not been detailed in the provided coverage.
